concerns.text: FR-001 and FR-002 require the system to output a unified time-series dataset (data/processed/unified_timeseries.csv). Task T015 (Create main.py entry point) is unchecked, and T016 (Validation) is unchecked. Without T015, the pipeline has no orchestration to produce the required artifact, leaving FR-001/FR-002 unfulfillable.

FR-004 and FR-008 require correlation results (coefficients, p-values) and visualization. Task T022 (Visualization) and T024 (P-value validation) are unchecked. T020 is checked but explicitly states it saves results; however, T022 is required to generate the plots mandated by the 'Independent Test' for US2, and T024 is required to validate the significance threshold (SC-002).

FR-006 and SC-004 require deriving modulation amplitudes, fitting a diffusion model, and reporting R²/F-test results. Tasks T028 (Amplitude derivation), T029 (Model fit), T030 (R²/F-test), T031 (Error handling), and T032 (Validation report) are all unchecked. The 'Independent Test' for US3 cannot be satisfied without these tasks.

Spec Edge Cases and Assumptions require handling Solar Cycle 24/25 transition (T040), collinearity diagnostics (T039), and sensitivity analysis for lag windows (T042). These tasks are unchecked, leaving the spec's edge-case handling and robustness assumptions unimplemented.

Tasks T001 (Project structure), T002 (Dependencies), and T003 (Linting) are marked unchecked in the list, yet the 'Analyze Report' indicates they were 'rejected' in a re-plan section. This creates a stale state where foundational tasks are neither implemented nor explicitly removed from the active list, causing confusion on whether the project structure exists.
